name: quirq
description: Install, open and manage XO Space locally from Codex. Browse projects, agent sessions, todos and usage in your workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Your local agent workspace, inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Open XO Space from Codex to browse projects, sessions, todos and usage. On first use, Codex installs the local server into a durable workspace and starts it with the Codex backend. Existing installations keep their settings. Requires a local macOS, Linux or WSL environment with git and an authenticated Codex CLI.
